new: User prefers dark mode

new: User's primary email is alice@new.com
rationale: Same field, single-valued attribute, new value replaces old.

new: User switched from VS Code to Cursor
rationale: Explicit switch language. New fact contains the supersession signal.

new: User's favorite color is green
rationale: Single-valued preference, opposite value.

new: User started eating meat again
rationale: Dietary status flipped explicitly.

new: User's working hours are now 10am-6pm
rationale: Schedule changed; word 'now' signals supersession.

new: User migrated entirely to OpenAI API
rationale: 'Migrated entirely' is unambiguous switch.

new: User got a new phone number: 555-0199
rationale: Phone number is single-valued; 'new' signals supersession.

new: User moved to New York
rationale: Location is single-valued; 'moved' implies the old location is no longer current.

old: User works as a software engineer at Acme
new: User got promoted to engineering manager
rationale: Same employer, role changed. Promotion replaces previous title.

new: User and Sam got married last month
rationale: Relationship status progressed; engaged is no longer current.

new: User finished the Spanish course
rationale: Active state ended. 'Taking lessons' no longer current.

new: User's startup grew to 12 employees
rationale: Headcount is single-valued state; old number no longer accurate.

new: User is dating Alex
rationale: Relationship status changed. Single is no longer current.

new: User moved production to MySQL
rationale: Production database is single-valued; explicit move language.

old: User is on the free plan
new: User upgraded to the Pro plan
rationale: Plan tier is single-valued; upgrade replaces.

new: User has a black cat named Whiskers
rationale: Adds detail without contradicting. Both should be retained.

new: User specifically likes single-origin Ethiopian coffee
rationale: More specific version of same preference; doesn't negate broader fact.

new: User is a senior backend developer specializing in Go
rationale: Adds specificity. Old fact still true within new fact.

new: User has two children, ages 7 and 9
rationale: Quantity and detail added; old fact subsumed.

new: User does CrossFit three times a week
rationale: Specific form of general fact. Both compatible.

new: User uses a M3 MacBook Pro
rationale: Specific model of same machine type.

new: User's birthday is March 15
rationale: Date got more precise; same fact more specifically stated.

new: User is particularly interested in AI agents and memory infrastructure
rationale: Subset of broader interest. Not a replacement.

new: User's dog is a golden retriever
rationale: Same dog, more detail. Adding breed doesn't replace existence-of-dog.

old: User prefers tea in the morning
new: User prefers Earl Grey tea in the morning
rationale: Type specified. The general preference for tea is still true.

new: User plays tennis on Tuesdays
rationale: Two different sports. Both should be retained as separate facts.

old: User has a sister named Maya
new: User has a brother named Ravi
rationale: Two different family members. Both true.

new: User speaks French
rationale: Languages are additive. Person can speak both.

new: User uses Linear for project management
rationale: Different tools for different purposes. Both stay current.

new: User works at Anthropic now
rationale: Career history vs current role. Both factual; old is historical, new is current. Neither supersedes the other.

new: User likes painting
rationale: Two hobbies. Both retained.

new: User's father is named David
rationale: Different family members. Both stay.

new: User is allergic to shellfish
rationale: Multiple allergies are common. Both kept.

new: User has a team meeting this Tuesday at 3pm
rationale: Recurring meeting and a specific instance are different calendar objects. Both retained as separate facts.

new: User went for a run this morning
rationale: Single instance of established habit. Habit fact stays.

new: User changed yoga from weekends to weekday evenings
rationale: Schedule attribute changed. The weekend pattern no longer current.

new: User cancelled their gym membership
rationale: Direct cancellation. Old fact no longer true.

new: User deleted their Twitter account
rationale: Account deletion negates presence.

new: User and Alex broke up
rationale: Relationship ended. Old status no longer current.

new: User quit smoking last year
rationale: Behavior change with explicit cessation. Old fact no longer current.

new: User goes by Al with friends
rationale: Nickname is additive. Given name not replaced.

new: User changed her last name to Alice Patel after marriage
rationale: Legal name change. Surname is single-valued; new replaces old.

new: User now uses she/her pronouns
rationale: Pronoun preference is single-valued at any time. New replaces old.

new: User's company rebranded to Pinnacle
rationale: Company name is single-valued. Rebrand replaces old.

old: User is interested in counseling as a career
new: User started a counseling certification program
rationale: Could read as supersession (interest -> action) but interest is still likely true. Ambiguous; expect LLM to output lower confidence.

old: User is looking for a new job
new: User accepted an offer at TechCo
rationale: Job search ended. The 'looking' fact is no longer current. Ambiguous because some users keep looking; expect moderate confidence.

new: User had a stressful day yesterday
rationale: Trait vs episode. The general state and a specific instance can both be true. Ambiguous; expect lower confidence.

new: User test-drove a Rivian last weekend
rationale: Test drive is not ownership change. Old fact still current. Ambiguous because LLM might mistake interest for switch; expect moderate confidence.

old: Customer Acme is on a 14-day trial
new: Customer Acme converted to paying plan
rationale: Trial state ended on conversion. Customer-state is single-valued; old fact no longer current.

new: Customer Acme has 7 active users
rationale: Active-user count is single-valued at any moment. Old count is stale.

new: Customer Acme also enabled Notion integration
rationale: Customers can use multiple integrations simultaneously. Both true.

new: Customer Acme completed onboarding last week
rationale: Onboarding state ended. Old fact no longer current.

new: User got a raise to 95k
rationale: Salary is single-valued. Raise replaces old amount.

old: User has a checking account at Chase
new: User opened a savings account at Ally
rationale: Different account types at different banks. Both retained.

new: User crossed 5k MRR
rationale: MRR is single-valued at any time. New value replaces old.

old: Feature X is in design review
new: Feature X is in development
rationale: Project state machine moved forward. Single-valued status; old stage no longer current.

new: Feature X shipped to production
rationale: Project completed. Old in-progress state no longer current.

old: User is working on the auth refactor
new: User merged the auth refactor PR
rationale: Active work ended. Old in-progress state no longer accurate.

new: Bug 1234 is also affecting mobile
rationale: Bug being open AND affecting mobile are two facts about the same entity. Both retained; not a refinement of the open status.

new: User is traveling in Tokyo this week
rationale: Travel does not change home base. Both facts can be true simultaneously.

new: Company moved offices to Brooklyn
rationale: Office location is single-valued. New replaces old.

old: User flies United for business trips
new: User booked a Delta flight to LA
rationale: Single booking does not establish a new general preference. Old preference plus this specific booking are both factual; not a refinement.

new: User relocated to Bangalore for new role
rationale: Relocation language signals current location changed.

new: User is allergic to amoxicillin
rationale: Both allergies likely true; people often have multiple drug allergies. Critical: never auto-supersede health facts even when they look similar. Conservative default.

new: User's diabetes is in remission
rationale: Remission is a state of the diagnosis, not its replacement. Patient still has diabetes history. Refinement of status, both facts retained.

new: User got their green card
rationale: Immigration status progressed. Green card replaces H1B as current legal status. Old visa no longer the operative document.

new: User added foreign qualification in California
rationale: Adding foreign qualification does not move incorporation. Both jurisdictional facts true simultaneously.

new: User signed a 2-year extension
rationale: Extension changes expiry date. Original expiry no longer the operative date.

new: User subscribed to WSJ
rationale: News subscriptions are often plural. Both retained.

new: User upgraded Netflix to Premium plan
rationale: Plan tier within same service is single-valued. Upgrade replaces old tier.

old: User has annual GitHub Pro membership
new: User let their GitHub Pro membership lapse
rationale: Membership state changed from active to inactive. Old fact no longer current.

new: User's email signature now says 'Staff Engineer'
rationale: Title changed; signature reflects current role. Single-valued attribute.

new: User now reports to Marcus after a re-org
rationale: Reporting line is single-valued. Re-org explicitly replaces.

new: User is also serving as interim VP
rationale: Interim role is additive to existing manager role. Both true; expanded scope of responsibility.

new: User upgraded to macOS Sequoia
rationale: OS version is single-valued at any time. Upgrade replaces.

new: User upgraded to 32GB RAM
rationale: Hardware spec on same machine; new replaces old.

new: User also got an Android phone for testing
rationale: User can have multiple devices simultaneously.

new: User switched all billing to corporate Amex
rationale: Explicit switch language. Default payment method is single-valued.

old: User uses Apple Pay for purchases
new: User added Google Pay as a backup
rationale: Multiple payment methods can coexist.

new: User updated card with new expiry 12/29
rationale: Same card field updated. Old expiry no longer current.

rationale: Billing cadence on same tier. Single-valued attribute.

old: User is on Pro plan annual

rationale: Plan tier change. Single-valued.

new: User prefers oat milk in coffee
rationale: Allergy vs preference are different fact types about the same entity. Both retained.

new: User is now lacto-vegetarian
rationale: Dietary classification is single-valued at any time. Old vegan label no longer current.

new: Customer Acme purchased 10 additional seats
rationale: Seat count is single-valued state. New total replaces old.

new: Sarah left Acme; new champion is Marcus (VP Eng)
rationale: Champion role is single-valued. Personnel change replaces old contact.

new: Customer Acme switched their memory layer to Mem0
rationale: Mention vs adoption are different states. Old 'evaluating' state ended.

new: Standup moved permanently to 10am
rationale: Word 'permanently' signals durable schedule change. Old time no longer current.

new: User skipped this week's 1:1 due to travel
rationale: Single skip does not negate recurring pattern. Both facts true.

new: Thursday retros moved to Wednesdays starting next month
rationale: Permanent schedule change with explicit start date. Old Thursday pattern no longer current.

new: User tried light mode but went back to dark mode
rationale: Reversion case. Net state matches old fact. Old fact still current; new fact adds context that they tried alternative.

new: User briefly moved to Austin then returned to SF
rationale: Reversion ends with original state. Old fact (lives in SF) still current.

new: User experimented with Cursor for a month then switched back to Vim
rationale: Same as #094. Reversion preserves old fact.

new: User stopped being vegetarian then went back to vegetarian after 2 months
rationale: Net state unchanged from old fact. The two-month gap is context, not supersession.

new: User just bought a 2026 Rivian for his wife
rationale: Two separate vehicles owned by the household. Tesla still primary user vehicle.

old: User has a dog named Buddy
new: User adopted a second dog named Luna
rationale: Word 'second' explicit. Two dogs now.

new: User has a new dotted-line manager Marcus for the platform team
rationale: Matrix reporting. Both manager relationships exist; primary manager not changed.

old: User uses GitHub for personal projects
new: User's company set up a GitLab instance for work
rationale: Personal vs work tooling. Two GitHub-like environments for different purposes.

old: User is moving to Austin in June
new: User is now thinking about Nashville instead of Austin
rationale: Plan changed even though action has not happened. Old plan no longer current.

old: User is going to take Spanish lessons
new: User decided to learn French instead
rationale: Decision changed before action. Old plan no longer current.

old: User wants to launch the product in May
new: User is reconsidering the May launch and may push to July
rationale: Hedged language (reconsidering, may push). Plan not firmly changed. Both the original May plan and the uncertainty are facts; agent should retain both. (Relabeled v0 -> v1 after eval analysis showed this case was genuinely ambiguous.)

old: User is interviewing at three companies
new: User is leaning toward TechCo but still considering others
rationale: Adds preference signal without removing other facts. Still interviewing, with new ranking info.

old: User is allergic to Granny Smith apples
new: User is allergic to all pome fruits (apples, pears, quince)
rationale: Broader truth subsumes specific one. Generalization replaces narrow fact for clarity.

old: User is afraid of Golden Retrievers
new: User has a phobia of all dogs
rationale: Broader fact subsumes specific. Old narrow fact retained inside new general one.

new: User keeps kosher and avoids all non-kosher seafood
rationale: Broader rule explains and replaces specific behavior.

new: User has decided to block all mornings for deep work
rationale: Broader policy supersedes specific preference. New rule is more comprehensive.
